# The WebCam - Intelligent Security Surveillance Console

> The WebCam is an AI-powered intelligent security surveillance web application providing real-time object detection (YOLOv8), face recognition, multi-camera monitoring, restricted zone boundary monitoring, and automated security rule alerts.

## Primary Capabilities
- **Live Monitor**: Live client hardware camera (laptop webcam, USB PC camera, mobile rear/front camera) and IP camera feed ingestion.
- **AI Object Detection**: Real-time detection of people, electronics, vehicles, and backpacks with bounding box tracking.
- **Face Recognition**: Vectorized facial identification against enrolled authorized/visitor identity databases.
- **Restricted Zones**: Custom polygon boundary drawing and automated intrusion detection.
- **Rule Engine**: Dwell-time thresholds, loitering alerts, and severity policy evaluation.
- **Evidence Gallery**: Audit trail snapshots of triggered security incidents.

## APIs & Integration
- `GET /api/system/health`: System health and AI detector load status.
- `GET /api/cameras`: Camera registry and device source management.
- `POST /api/stream/{camera_id}/ingest_frame`: Real-time external video frame processing.
- `GET /api/alerts`: Real-time and historical security alerts.
